title: Letter of Transmittal
content:
{{client.name_display}}
{{client.address_display}}

{{valuation.report_date}}

Dear Sir,

RE: {{property.type_display}} PROPERTY ({{property.name}}) ON PLOT OF LAND SITUATE AT {{property.neighborhood_uppercase}} WITH GHANA POST DIGITAL ADDRESS {{property.gps_address}}

Pursuant to the REQUEST commissioning me to carry out valuation on the above-named property (hereinafter referred to as "the property"), I have completed the exercise and have the pleasure to present to you the report. A careful inspection of the property located at {{property.neighborhood}} was made giving due consideration to all factors and forces influencing property values. The report is, thus, based on an analysis of general and specific data that influence residential and commercial property value as reported herein.

The purpose of this valuation is for {{valuation.purpose_description}}. The {{valuation.methods_applied}} has been considered in the appraisal and has been utilized where necessary or deemed appropriate for the value conclusion arrived.

In my professionally considered opinion, having regard to the Existing Use, State/Condition, location, economic, legal, physical and institutional factors, the value of the respective interest in the subject {{property.land_area_display}} property located at {{property.neighborhood}} is as stated in the Valuation Summary below.

  • Market Value: {{valuation.final_value_words}} [{{valuation.final_value_formatted}}] equivalent to {{valuation.final_value_usd_words}} [{{valuation.final_value_usd_formatted}}]
  • Forced Sale Value: {{valuation.force_sale_value_words}} [{{valuation.force_sale_value_formatted}}] equivalent to {{valuation.force_sale_value_usd_words}} [{{valuation.force_sale_value_usd_formatted}}]

as at the date of valuation.

It has been a pleasure working on your behalf in this matter. Please feel free to let me know if you desire additional information concerning this report, or if I may be of further assistance to you.

Yours faithfully,

___________________________________

{{valuer.name}}, {{valuer.qualifications}}
({{valuer.title}})
GhIS Registration No: {{valuer.registration_number}}
